title: APR-OIS: A Near-Sensor Point Cloud Pre-Processing Accelerator on FPGA
problem: Raw point clouds from 3D sensors (LiDAR, RGB-D cameras) contain enormous numbers of points and require expensive down-sampling to reduce data while preserving spatial structure before use in point cloud applications.
motivation: Point cloud down-sampling is a computationally expensive preprocessing step that benefits from hardware acceleration near the sensor to improve efficiency.
method: The paper proposes APR-OIS (Approximate Octree-Indexed Sampling), an approximation method that accelerates Octree-based down-sampling by exploiting spatial proximity properties of Octree nodes. The method is implemented as an FPGA-based accelerator functioning as a near-sensor processor on raw 3D sensor data.
key_novelty: An approximation method (APR-OIS) that achieves significant acceleration in Octree-based point cloud down-sampling with minimal accuracy loss.
contributions: APR-OIS approximation algorithm for Octree-indexed point cloud down-sampling
FPGA accelerator design for near-sensor point cloud preprocessing
Demonstration of acceleration with minimal accuracy loss
Near-sensor processing architecture for 3D sensor data
